content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Ogden

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires a combination of formal education and documented project-management experience. Review PMI's eligibility criteria to verify your background qualifies. Ogden's manufacturing, aerospace, and defense sectors employ many professionals who already meet these requirements through on-the-job leadership.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP course. Our Ogden-based trainers deliver the PMI-required contact hours on a schedule that fits working professionals. You'll learn the PMBOK® Guide framework and real-world project scenarios in real time.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: Create your PMI account and submit your formal PMP application, including your education credentials and project experience. Pay the applicable PMI exam fee and wait for approval. Granite PM Academy can guide you through the submission process to ensure accuracy.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Access Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources, including practice tests and targeted study materials. Schedule your exam at a Pearson Vue testing center. On exam day, you'll demonstrate mastery of project-management domains through a rigorous, proctored assessment.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: After certification, commit to earning Professional Development Units (PDUs) over a three-year renewal cycle. Attend workshops, complete coursework, and engage in project-management activities to stay current. Recertify by submitting your PDU record and renewal fee to PMI.

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI requires either a four-year degree with 36 months of project leadership experience, or a high school diploma with 60 months of experience. All applicants need 35 contact hours of PM education — our course satisfies this requirement.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
fq_items.answer: After completing training, PMI typically approves applications within 5–10 business days. Once approved, you have one year to sit for the exam. Most students study 4–8 weeks after the course before scheduling their exam.
